lines.en: I tramp the dry plain grass.
My armour clicks plate by plate.

lines.zh: 我一步在土上留一个坑
lines.en: Each step leaves a pit in the soil.
I skirt the edge of the wheat.
My steel claws land, then lift.

lines.zh: 我拖着尾巴慢慢地拐弯
lines.en: I turn slowly, tail dragging.
I head back toward my anchor.

lines.zh: 我把路上的一块石头踩碎
lines.en: I crush a stone in the path.
I squeeze past a tree sideways.
My dorsal fin shines in the sun.
I take another stride.
I walk a straight line over the grass.
My snout is down, sniffing.
I halt, then go on.
I stand planted on the plain.
My chest plate rises and falls.

lines.zh: 我呼出的气带着机油味
lines.en: My breath carries a whiff of oil.
I keep my steel claws before me.
I watch without blinking.
I stand without stirring.
I turn my head to one side.
My tail lies on the grass.
I am waiting for orders.
I ease my shoulders a little.
I snort out hot air.
I face toward my anchor.

lines.zh: 我背上的导弹架轻轻响
lines.en: The launcher on my back clicks.
The light shows me the distance.
I lower my head to see you.
You are not up to my instep.
I turn my steel head sideways.
My steel claws scrape the dirt.

lines.zh: 你身上的味道我有点印象
lines.en: Your smell is somewhat familiar.
I will look you over before speaking.
I am in no hurry to step in.
Put down what you are holding.
My tail sweeps a half circle of grass.
I plant half a step closer.
You may stand and keep still.
My snout comes toward you.
I dip my head a little lower.
I have my eye on your wrist.

lines.zh: 我鼻孔里喷出两道白气。
lines.en: Two plumes of hot air leave my nostrils.
I wait for you to state your business.
My chest plate is driven in.
I give a step.

lines.zh: 我的胸口，装着一枚导弹。
lines.en: A missile sits in my chest.
I look down at the breach.
I plant both feet again.
My claws dig into the earth.
I make no sound at all.
That damage is nothing.
I twist my upper body round.
A dent in the metal shell.
That is the smell of meat.
I step that way.
I lower my head to sniff.
One clench and it is gone.
That is not enough to chew.
I will take some more.
I lick the plate by my jaw.
I raise my head, waiting.
Head down again, I searched once more.
I give half a step of room.
I press a claw to the ground.
I look back at your hand.
You ram me and I do not give an inch.
My chest plate shoves you off.

lines.zh: 你撞上我的胸甲，退开半步。
lines.en: You hit my chest plate and fall back.
I glance down at you.
We knock and the plates ring.
My claws rake the ground.
I cannot feel that much.
I set my feet apart again.
That charge is not worth much.
I square my upper body.
Another comes from the far wheat.
The two of us stand abreast.
Its armour is darker than mine.
We head for the anchor together.
It rumbles low in its throat.
I touch its brow with mine.
We stop and make no more sound.
It takes the first step.
I walk at its left.
Our two suits of armour ring together.
I stoop and scoop it up.
I bring it to my snout.
I tip my head back and swallow.
I lick my steel claw.
I pin it under a foot.
I shake my head twice.
I lower my snout to search.
I sweep it off with a claw.
I stop looking at it.
I turn and walk off.
My faceplate lines up on you.
I swing my upper body that way.
A light glints in my chest seam.
The launcher on my back opens.
I have you marked.
I spread the steel claws at my sides.
This one will not be light.
I bear down on that spot.
My tail snaps taut.
Fire control is ready.
My steel claws clench.
I am stepping in now.
I move with your tread.
I close in a step at a time.
You cut left; I turn left.
The muzzle stays on you.
I am in no hurry to fire.
You are behind a stone.

lines.zh: 我用尾巴把那片碎石扫开
lines.en: My tail sweeps the rubble away.
I have your pattern down.
I come by another line.
You have glanced up.
This is the right range.
I lower my head to aim.
I bring a claw down.
My steel claw tears its armour.
I loose a missile.
The blast blooms at its feet.
I drive my pauldron into it.
It slides a long way.
I clamp its shoulder in my jaws.
My tail sweeps its waist.
It checks my first claw.
I hammer down another claw.
My steel arm rings out long.
It backs off; I do not chase.
I come stepping in from a distance.
My armour throws one flash.
My weight presses a pit in the earth.
I stop in the middle of the plain.
I press my steel claws into the earth.
I raise my head and sweep the horizon.
Oil hangs in the air.
I recognise my anchor.
I bring my upper body up slowly.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴把草扫出一条道
lines.en: My tail sweeps a lane through the grass.
I begin to patrol this ground.
My eyes flash once.

lines.zh: 我把这块地圈成自己的。
lines.en: I claim this ground as mine.
I blow out a hot breath.
Fire heats my leg plates.
I crash down from a height.
The water barely reaches my knee.
The blast rips my pauldron off.

lines.zh: 有东西打在装甲上弹开
lines.en: Something strikes my armour and skips off.
Spell light boils the oil in my joints.
Hunger keeps my steel claw down.
Lightning runs through all my armour.

lines.zh: 我脚下没有任何着力处
lines.en: There is nothing to stand on.
